feed.title: learn.web — updates
feed.subtitle: A free, project-based field guide to the modern web. What changed, when, and why.

entry.title: v3.0 — Indexable lessons, a beginner on-ramp, and My Studio
entry.summary: Every lesson now has its own URL you can share and search engines can index. Web Foundations joins the curriculum (thirty-six lessons across six paths), knowledge checks doubled to two questions, code workspaces gained hints, and My Studio tracks your artifacts, backups, and a printable certificate.

entry.title: v2.0 — The July 2026 curriculum
entry.summary: Added the Modern Web Platform path alongside UX, accessibility, search and AI discovery, and AI product engineering. Reframed all thirty lessons around an artifact and a definition of done, added the live lab, command-palette search, capability detection, and local progress.

entry.title: v1.0 — Launch
entry.summary: The field guide launched as a free, project-based path through the modern web: accessible, search-aware, evidence-driven, and honest about what changes.
